description: This Java source file defines the TextHandler class, which manages storing and retrieving complex text data in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It handles reading and writing text-based complex observations (Obs), supports different views such as text, raw, and URI, and interacts with storage services for file management.

classes.name: TextHandler
classes.description: A component class that implements handling of complex text data of observations, supporting reading from and writing to storage, and providing different data views.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves complex observation data based on the specified view (text, raw, URI) and populates the Obs object with the data from storage.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns the list of data views supported by this handler: text, raw, and URI.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves the complex data contained within an Obs object to storage, updates its metadata, and prepares it for retrieval.
